candidates.old:
JMP next
.each
    LDY #1
    LDA (col_ptr),Y                 \ the count
    BEQ empty
    DEC A                           \ 65C02 opcode: count - 1, the record's and the cell loop's
    STA rows_m1
    LDY #8
    STA (v_ptr),Y                   \ the record: count - 1 (then the address)
    LDA ds_line                     \ the lowest byte's line: the part's line - the first row
    SEC                             \ drawn (below 0: a cell up for each 8)
    SBC (col_ptr)                   \ 65C02 opcode
    TAX
    LDA rows_m1                     \ col_ptr on to the next column: 2 + count bytes (the data
    SEC                             \ is found back from there)
    ADC #2
    ADC col_ptr
    STA col_ptr
    BCC on_same_page
    INC col_ptr + 1
.on_same_page
candidates.new:
JMP next
    SKIP 12
.each_cross                         \ the column's end crossed a page (rare): the same, then the high byte on
    LDA ds_line
    SEC
    SBC (col_ptr)
    TAX
    STY col_ptr
    INC col_ptr + 1
    BRA on_same_page                \ 65C02 opcode
.each
    LDY #1
    LDA (col_ptr),Y                 \ the count
    BEQ empty
    DEC A                           \ 65C02 opcode: count - 1, the record's and the cell loop's
    STA rows_m1
    LDY #8
    STA (v_ptr),Y                   \ the record: count - 1 (then the address)
    SEC                             \ col_ptr on to the next column: 2 + count bytes (the data
    ADC #2                          \ is found back from there): A = count + 2 (C = 0)
    ADC col_ptr                     \ the new low byte, kept in Y until the first row is read
    TAY                             \ (TAY leaves C: the page crossing)
    BCS each_cross
    LDA ds_line                     \ the lowest byte's line: the part's line - the first row
    SEC                             \ drawn (below 0: a cell up for each 8)
    SBC (col_ptr)                   \ 65C02 opcode
    TAX
    STY col_ptr
.on_same_page
candidates.summary: ALT 1 (best; overlaps ALT 2 and 3, the same code with a different pad): the column's col_ptr advance without reloading rows_m1 (new low byte kept in Y while the first row is read at the old pointer), the rare page crossing in its own block after JMP next, and a 12-byte SKIP in that dead zone that moves the bank-4 code after it onto better page alignment.
candidates.equivalence: Same arithmetic: A = count-1 (the DEC A), then SEC; ADC #2; ADC col_ptr, as the old LDA rows_m1/SEC/ADC #2/ADC col_ptr did (rows_m1 is still stored for the cell loop). The new low byte waits in Y (TAY leaves C) while SBC (col_ptr) reads the first row at the OLD pointer, then STY col_ptr. A carry (page crossing, rare) goes to each_cross: same SBC with the high byte not yet advanced, STY col_ptr, INC col_ptr+1, rejoin at on_same_page. At on_same_page col_ptr (both bytes), X (the line) and rows_m1 equal the old values on both paths. Differences left: A (old new low byte, new the line), Y (old 8, new the new low byte), C: every successor overwrites them before reading (clip_test loads ds_n/ds_c, visible loads b_ptr, raised LDY #9, save_on_page TAY; C is not live: annotations show C=?). col_ptr is written later than before but nothing reads it between (renderer scratch, not the interrupt's). Entries (JMP each, BRA each, BPL/BCC draw_column.each, BEQ empty) unchanged; each_cross sits after JMP next, reached only by BCS each_cross (about 22 bytes back; its BRA about 30 forward). Overflow case (count >= 254) has the same arithmetic as before. SKIP in the dead zone is never executed.
candidates.relies_on: Grows bank 4 by 21 bytes (9 without the pad); everything after slides. MEASURED 2026-10-22 on a private copy of HEAD 3db31c8 + this edit, bench build (DEBUG_LIVES unshifted), pcprof --unclobber --detail, work = render+interrupts+logic: seed 1 34457 -> 34384 (-73), RIGHT 39690 -> 39615 (-75). Without the pad (ALT 3) it is -19/-26: the code itself is 2 cycles x 10.8 non-empty columns; the rest is alignment (render -40, and logic -33 from a branch after it no longer crossing). BPL raised crosses &9B->&9C in the control (+1 taken, about 9 columns a pass); with this pad the BPL's next instruction is at &9C00, so it no longer crosses. BCC/BEQ visible, BMI clip_test, BEQ empty stay on &9B; the .byte, .part_byte and .cell loops stay within one page. The 12 is tuned to the code before it in bank 4: if an earlier kept change moves this code, ALT 3 is the fallback. passlock on ALT 3 (seed 1 500 passes, seed 3 2500, --screen) identical to the control; ALT 1 differs only by the unexecuted SKIP.
